newsitem.title: CHINA: China angered by Taiwan official at EU parliament.
newsitem.headline: China angered by Taiwan official at EU parliament.

text.p: China expressed strong indignation on Thursday over the European parliament's invitation to Taiwan Foreign Minister John Chang to address the body.
"We are ... strongly indignant about this," said Foreign Ministry spokesman Shen Guofang. "This is gross interference in China's internal affairs."
Shen told reporters that the European parliament should stop taking actions harmful to the reunification of Taiwan with China.

Chang is in Belgium on a European trip, and Taiwan's state television has said the minister has been invited to address the European Parliament, which has lent moral support to Taiwan in its bitter rivalry with communist Beijing.
Taiwan and China have been divided since the end of the Chinese civil war in 1949.

Beijing views the island as a renegade province and has steadily tightened a diplomatic squeeze on Taipei in a quest to bring Taiwan under its rule. It has warned other countries not to exchange ties with Taipei or permit visits by senior Taiwan officials.
